territorial_scope.description: Applies to projects and activities subject to the SEIA in Chile, as the national regulation amended by this decree.

evidence.provision: Artículo único
evidence.quote: Modifícase el decreto supremo Nº 40, de 2012, del Ministerio del Medio Ambiente

summary.short: Amends Chile's Decree 40 (2012), the environmental impact assessment regulation, by revising project-type thresholds that determine whether projects must enter the SEIA. Addressed to project proponents; the text states no entry-into-force date. No AI-specific provisions.
summary.long: Amends Supreme Decree No. 40 (2012), which establishes the Regulation of the Environmental Impact Assessment System (SEIA), through a single article with three numbered items. Item 1 amends the entry rule for project modifications in Art. 2 literal g.1. Item 2 amends the project-type list in Art. 3: it defines high-voltage transmission lines (over 23 kV and 2 km), replaces several numeric thresholds with higher values (for example liquid storage from 200,000 L to 850,000 L, and waste treatment population thresholds from 10,000 to 15,000 and from 2,500 to 5,000 inhabitants), revises area, volume, throughput and capacity thresholds for aquaculture, toxic, explosive, flammable, corrosive and reactive substances, land transport, and solid, liquid and hazardous waste systems, adds an exemption for certain mining tailings reprocessing, and deletes the peat reference and literal i.6. Item 3 adds literal d.7 to Art. 60 on the project typologies applicable to project parts, works or actions. Thresholds are expressed in tonnes, cubic metres, kilograms, square metres and inhabitants. The text states no entry-into-force date, contains no penalty provisions, and contains no AI-specific provisions.

notes: Only the Artículo único operative provisions amend DS 40/2012: art. 2 literal g.1, art. 3 literals a to w, and new literal d.7 in art. 60. Considerandos 6.1-6.3 list earlier amendments to DS 40 (DS 8/2014, DS 63/2014, DS 30/2023); these are not coded as relations of this instrument. Considerando 12 says the procedure was split from draft Resolución 664/2025 and limited to the SEIA entry routes (vías de ingreso), while some operative changes also touch modification criteria in g.1; readers should check scope. Item 2.w deletes the final paragraph of letter o) without quoting it, and item 2.o renumbers paragraphs, so the deleted text is identified only by position. Item 2.s has a punctuation error (o.7.1 ends with a semicolon and o.7.2 sits outside the quotation). The text gives no publication or entry-into-force date. Threshold values are not coded in this annotation. The section_status values are placeholders required by the schema and do not indicate absence of entries.

obligations.summary: Adds literal d.7 to the first paragraph of art. 60, listing the project's typologies under art. 3 (applicable to its parts, works or actions) as an item of that article's content list. The inserted text contains no express verb of duty.

evidence.provision: Artículo único, numeral 3 (inserting art. 60 inciso primero, literal d.7)
evidence.quote: d.7 Las tipologías del proyecto o actividad, así como las aplicables a sus partes, obras o acciones, de acuerdo al artículo 3 de este Reglamento.

enforcement.note: The decree amends SEIA thresholds and entry criteria in Art. 3 and adds literal d.7 to Art. 60. The text contains no fines, penalties, licence revocations, clawbacks, suspensions or blocking provisions, and it does not reproduce any enforcement regime from the parent law.
